extracted.intended_audience: Public Information Officers (new or less experienced), established PIOs seeking refresher training, and new emergency managers (attendees of Florida Fire & EMS Conference)
extracted.subtask_description: A three-day FEMA L0105 Public Information Officer basics course covering core PIO skills (news release writing, media interviews, social media, strategic communications) intended for new/refreshing PIOs and required for the FEMA National Emergency Management Basic Academy. Includes prerequisite completion and certificate issuance requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended audience / eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: It is intended for Public Information Officers who are new to the field or less experienced, established PIOs who desire to refresh their training, new emergency managers, and is a required course for the FEMA National Emergency Management Basic Academy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course length / curriculum update
rubrics_metrics.description: FAPIO now offers the updated FEMA Basic PIO curriculum, expanded from two to three days of training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-day format implies expanded coverage of core topics and more instructional time than prior two-day offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course emphasis / core learning objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: The course emphasis is on the basic skills and knowledge needed for public safety, emergency management and government/municipal public information activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad objective covering foundational PIO functions across public safety and government contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic: the role of the PIO
rubrics_metrics.description: Topics include: the role of the PIO

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic: news release writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit inclusion indicates practical instruction on preparing news releases as a core PIO deliverable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic: conducting media interviews and news conferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Topics include: conducting media interviews and news conferences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers live media interaction skills and management of press events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic: strategic communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Likely covers planning and messaging strategies across incidents and campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic: social media
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates training on use of social platforms for public information during incidents and routine communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prerequisite: FEMA IS-29.A (Public Information Officer Awareness)
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a prerequisite for the L0105 that can be completed online: FEMA IS-29.A (Public Information Officer Awareness).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students must complete IS-29.A and provide proof before their L0105 certificate will be issued; link and requirement to have a FEMA student identification number are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required administrative item: FEMA student identification number and proof of completion
rubrics_metrics.description: You need a FEMA student identification number (https://cdp.dhs.gov/FEMASID). You will need to provide proof of your IS-29.A certificate before your L0105 certificate will be issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative prerequisite: obtain FEMA SID and retain IS-29.A completion certificate to present for L0105 certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended prior training (NIMS courses)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strongly recommended, though not required, are the following National Incident Management System (NIMS) courses: IS-100.B, IS-200.B, IS-700.A, IS-800.B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These NIMS courses provide foundational ICS/NIMS context that complements PIO training but are not mandatory for enrollment or certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost / fee structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost for this class is $150 Course Only | $200 Bundle with PIO Symposium. The cost for this class is $150, and you’ll receive half-off admission to the PIO Symposium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing options include standalone course or bundle with symposium; promotional benefit (half-off symposium admission) applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration and logistical details
rubrics_metrics.description: REGISTER FOR FEMA L0105 PIO BASICS. Location: Orange County Convention Center | 9899 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registration required; logistical information (venue/address) provided for planning attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Networking opportunity: PIO Networking Dinner
rubrics_metrics.description: PIO Networking Dinner (Dutch treat). This is a chance for PIOs to catch up, network and meet our speakers before Friday’s symposium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional social event for professional networking; attendee pays own way ('Dutch treat').

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication / follow-up: mailing list
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our mailing list and keep up to date with details about the Florida Fire & EMS Conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for updates and additional details; recommended to stay informed about course and symposium changes.
